title: Album release: Liverpool 8 by Ringo Starr | 2008
content:
Liverpool 8, Ringo Starr’s fifteenth solo studio album, was released worldwide on 14 January 2008.

The album was streamed ahead of its release at vh1classic.com.

The title track was released as the first single on 7 January 2008, on compact disc and digital download.

Liverpool 8 followed one week later, being available on CD, USB wristband, and digital download. It reached numbers 91 and 94 in the UK and US charts respectively.

Page last updated: 8 September 2021
